plain.li: In the dream the power ran out of me like water from a split bucket, and I couldn't find the hole.
Dreamt I was working something enormous, a spell the size of the valley, and every word of it was right.
[again] The same working again in my sleep. I get further each time before I wake.
[trait:InnerFire] Everything I touched caught light, gently, like candles. Nothing burned.
[trait:HeartOfFrost] The river froze under my feet, one step at a time, all the way across.
[trait:Druid|trait:TM_Shaman] The trees were talking, slowly, about the weather. I understood most of it.
[trait:Necromancer] The dead lined up in my dream to tell me their names. I wrote every one of them down.
[storm] The lightning came down to my hand when I called it, and waited there.

cheerful.li: I lifted the whole storeroom with one finger and set it down on the hill, where the light is better.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the power was gone and nobody noticed. They just went on eating.

cold.li: Dreamt in sigils again. Three of them were new. I've drawn them on the wall before they fade.

plain.li: There was a book in my dream, open on a table, and the words kept moving just before I could read them.
A power I'd never been taught, in the dream. It felt like remembering, not learning.
[again] The book again. This time I read the first line, and I've forgotten it already.
[trait:PhysicalProdigy] In the dream I fought in a way I've never been taught, and every move was right.

cheerful.li: [trait:TM_Gifted] Dreamt I could do magic! Small magic, nothing fancy. It felt completely ordinary, which was the best part.

gloomy.li: Something in me is waiting to be used. I felt it in the dream, and I still feel it now.
